notes: Totals and derived stats from ESPN raw box scores on disk. NBA 2026-27, 48-minute games, %Min over games x 48. experience_years / is_rookie / age / height_in / weight_lbs come from data/rosters_2026_27.json when it exists (is_rookie means experience.years == 0, first NBA season); they are None / False when rosters have not been pulled or the player is on no current roster. Percentages are null when the denominator is zero. DNP players are excluded. ratings.ortg is a simplified ORtg (points per 100 possessions used, no assist credit), an approximation of KenPom's full Dean Oliver formula. ratings.rpr IS RPR v1.2 (Nov 20, 2026): ORtg shrunk toward the league-average ORtg (K = 200 possessions used; prior is this season's league average, no prior season exists in this project) and adjusted for the defences faced (OppAdj, shrunk toward 0 with K = 500 possessions faced; see player_profiles.py docstring), with the counting terms centered on the league-average per-36 rates (rpr_centers_per36), so an average player scores about 0. ratings.rpr_v1 and ratings.rpr_v1_1 are the old uncentered values, kept in parallel. ratings.rpr_value = RPR v1.2 * GP / 82 (value delivered so far, separate from the per-game rating). shooting.ts_pct_shrunk and fg3_pct_shrunk are shrunk toward league rates (m = 170 / 750 attempts). RPR is our own single-number rating, not KenPom's proprietary kPOY.
